header.title: Your IT Team Strengthened Within 5 Business Days
header.subtitle: At Modual Equans, you get direct access to certified IT specialists who speak Dutch and English. From our office in Tangier (Morocco), we work in sync with the Netherlands—at 25% lower costs.

aboutUs.title: About Modual Equans
aboutUs.text: The Dutch job market is tight: developers are scarce, recruitment is expensive, and projects are often delayed. Modual Equans offers the solution. We provide IT specialists from Morocco who perfectly match your needs. Thanks to our Dutch contracts, quality guarantees, and fast start, you can work with confidence and flexibility.

ourPromise.title: Lower Costs, Higher Quality
ourPromise.text: Reduce development costs without compromising on performance. Deliver first-class results at a fraction of the usual cost.

ourPromise.title: Simple and Scalable
ourPromise.text: Whether you need one experienced developer or an entire team, our flexible model adapts to the size and timeline of your project.

ourPromise.title: Continuity and Security, Without Risk
ourPromise.text: Enjoy stable, secure, and risk-free collaboration with continuous support that ensures your business keeps running smoothly.

whyUs.title: Why Choose Us
reasons: Quality guarantee – if not satisfied, replacement within 30 days
Secure contracts according to Dutch standards

services.title: What We Do
services.subtitle: Discover our full range of expert digital services

services.title: Software Development
services.text: We create innovative web applications, develop stable backend systems, design user-friendly frontend interfaces, and deliver scalable cloud solutions that grow with your business.

services.title: Mobile Apps
services.text: We develop high-quality native iOS and Android apps, fully customized to support the unique needs of your business. Our mobile applications combine powerful performance, user-friendly interfaces, and reliable cloud integrations, ensuring your organization remains connected with customers, employees, and partners.

services.title: Cybersecurity
services.text: From audits and monitoring to pentests and SOC services, we support companies in detecting vulnerabilities, proactively managing risks, and complying with international security standards. Our approach ensures a secure, scalable, and future-proof digital environment.

services.title: DevOps & Cloud
services.text: We support organizations in setting up and optimizing modern IT infrastructure, automated CI/CD pipelines, and smart cloud solutions. With our DevOps approach, we accelerate software development, improve stability, and ensure scalable and reliable systems.

services.title: QA & Test Automation
services.text: From functional and regression testing to end-to-end test automation and performance testing, we help organizations launch their software faster, more securely, and flawlessly through advanced testing strategies that are both manual and automated.

services.title: Dedicated Teams
services.text: We build strong, custom development teams composed of full-time developers who seamlessly collaborate with your internal processes and tools. Whether it's for web, mobile, or cloud, our specialists bring expertise, flexibility, and scalability to your organization.

howWeWork.title: How We Work
howWeWork.subtitle: From vision and ideas to growth and results

steps.title: Introduction
steps.text: Tell us about your project, goals, and specific requirements.

steps.title: Selection
steps.text: We put together a team of certified IT specialists who are a perfect match.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.text: Your specialist starts within 5 business days.

steps.title: Guidance
steps.text: We provide training, office space, and support.

steps.title: Continuity
steps.text: You maintain control, we guarantee security.
